Overview

The Frigidaire 24" built-in dishwasher delivers effective cleaning and enhanced drying so you spend less time at the sink. Triple spray arms target every dish, while the MaxDry option helps minimize towel drying. Designed to fit medium to large households, it operates quietly at just 54 dB.
  • Fits 14 place settings—great for medium to large households
  • Quiet 54 dB operation; similar to normal conversation in another room

What you need to know
  • Built-in standard dishwasher designed for family kitchens and busy households
  • Triple spray arms provide thorough cleaning on every load
  • Quiet 54 dB rating blends into daily life without disruptive noise
  • MaxDry option delivers enhanced drying results and reduces towel drying
Cleaning Performance
  • Triple spray arms give your dishes a more effective clean and better water coverage
  • DishSense Sensor Technology adjusts cleaning based on the soil level of your dishes
  • 60-minute wash cycle quickly cleans your dishes
  • Pots and Pans cycle handles tough, heavily soiled cookware
Drying Performance
  • MaxDry raises the temperature for better drying results, reducing towel drying
  • Heated dry option boosts drying performance for better drying results
Ease of Use and Flexibility
  • Stay-put door allows you to open the door at any angle for easy loading or unloading
  • Delay start option lets you set the dishwasher to run on your schedule
Sanitization

Energy & Efficiency
